retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast male portrait featuring a dramatic orange radial sunburst effect against a dark, textured background with techno-inspired typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A shirtless male subject positioned off-center, illuminated by a powerful orange light source from the lower left that transitions into a dense array of thin, white radial lines emanating from the same origin point across a dark, grainy background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's skin tones mirroring the orange glow of the background burst
Radial lines creating a sense of energy and movement toward the upper right
High-contrast shadows on the subject's right side blending into the dark void
Typography aligned to the upper right quadrant to balance the visual weight of the burst
coreInvariants: Lower-left origin point for the radial burst
Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male subject, positioned slightly left of center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange focal point in the lower-left corner where the radial lines converge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright orange burst, follows the subject's torso upward, and is then directed by the radial lines toward the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space in the upper right and along the right edge, filled only by thin lines and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black/charcoal background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant safety orange used for the light source and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white for the secondary text and fine radial lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the glowing orange core and the dark periphery; high saturation in the light source.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to orange, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Crossbars that extend beyond the vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a traditional apex, appearing as a bridge
The 'R' has a detached or stylized leg
The 'Y' is simplified into a wide fork
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller sans-serif with extreme tracking is placed directly beneath the primary display text for a hierarchical 'sub-brand' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric, wide-set techno aesthetic.
Offers the squared-off, industrial feel common in 2000s urban design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a shirtless man in a dark environment with a powerful orange light source at the bottom left. Add a dense array of thin white lines radiating from that light source across the frame. Apply a subtle film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-wide, futuristic sans-serif text in the upper right corner. Use vibrant orange for the main title and white for the subtitle, ensuring wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the light source origin in the lower left?
Are the radial lines thin and consistent?
Is the typography horizontally stretched and wide-tracked?
Is the color palette strictly orange, black, and white?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Soft edges on the radial lines

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the radial lines converge at a single point.
Ensure the subject's skin reflects the orange light source.
Check that the text is legible against the line pattern.
Verify the absence of any unintended background elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + [Lower-Left Radial Burst] + [High-Contrast Orange/Black Palette] + [Ultra-Wide Techno Typography]
